summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing the temporary unavailability of Mercalot Inc.'s Android mobile application on Google Play. No special-situation event (M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) is described. The company is simply working to restore the app, with no definitive timeline. Under SEC guidelines, this operational update does not trigger a special-situations classification. Therefore, the appropriate category is None.
